fieldValues.statement: The owner keeps the clerk's authority rules over delegating them with its code
fieldValues.boundary_clause: unless the owner delegates a named authority rule explicitly, in a ratified decision.
fieldValues.context: Changes to gates, merge rules, quorum, budget, pause or the authority signal go to the owner, even after a group holds the clerk (a8bc55ef). A group may maintain the machinery that grants it authority, but may not change the grant.
